newsitem.title: MOROCCO: U.S. Soros sold off his 6.07 pct in Moroccan firm.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Soros sold off his 6.07 pct in Moroccan firm.

text.p: U.S. businessman George Soros successfully sold his 6.07 percent in Morocco's portfolio Financiere Diwan firm at $17.5 million on the bourse, the Casablanca-based CFG stockbroker said on Monday.

"Quantum Emerging Growth Partners fund, which is owned by U.S. George Soros, successfully sold 6.07 percent in Diwan firm or the equivalent of 500,000 shares at 330 dirhams ($35) per share," a CFG market analyst told Reuters.
The flotation took place on the Casablanca bourse from 26 to 30 May, 1997.
A stake of 300,000 shares was sold to the general public while the remaining 200,000 shares were purchased by institutional investors, the analyst said.
An official detailed statement on the flotation is expected to be issued on Tuesday, he added but gave no other details.
Soros initially owned nearly 13 percent stake in Diwan whose majority stake is held by Morocco's largest private holding ONA Group.
Only Morocco's leading banks Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur, Banque Commerciale du Maroc and Casablanca Finance Group brokerage house were allowed to sell Diwan's shares.
Diwan was traded last week at 355 dirhams, dealers said.
